_doc: check.py prove: which check runs for which touched paths (fnmatch, * spans folders). when_status adds a trigger on git statuses (D deleted, R renamed). cmd @selftests / @smokes are built in (check_prove.py). Order is run order; Godot runs stay last and one at a time.
_drift_allow: file|symbol pairs that name a removed thing on purpose (a selftest case that must reject the old form).

checks.why: allowlist on dirty paths, load graph, dupes gate (every diff; drift and textsize are this prove's own)

tool catalog rows, libs and data named
CLI contract of the changed tools
task headers; resume/first lines name live tools
selftest of each changed tool, tool importing a changed lib, or tool reading changed data
hub layout or bake inputs: committed bake still matches its stamp
shot flows still match the UI states
UI scripts: text size and in-play HUD cover on phone/tablet
smoke phases that load the changed scripts (gate.py bot-smokes --for)
editor import, load graph, shot gaps, release smoke
